comment: The character creator's base bodies (tools/makehuman/mh_creator.py, docs/design/makehuman.md). Each morph is a variant build of its base with these settings changed. Adults only: there is no younger morph. Shape<Part>Lo/Hi (sneed 2026-11-25, face variety): MakeHuman's own face modelling targets, one pair per face slider (SmokeTestCreator.cpp CreatorFaceShapes); every person's face is a blend of them, so they work with every expression unit, the hair fit (grow_hair.py measures any slider that moves the skull) and the gore. EthAfrican/EthAsian (sneed 2026-11-26): MakeHuman's own ethnic base shapes (European is what is left); 24 more Shape pairs (face and build); Face_CheekPuff and one-sided Face_<Unit>L/R ({"from", "side"}: mh_creator reuses the unit's build, mh_common.add_morphs keeps one side) for the facial capture (docs/design/faces-mocap.md).
